states.name: mil-ops-shortfall
states.description: Turn 2, the last action round (US to act, holding Duck and Cover; USSR holds Fidel). DEFCON 4; the US has 1 Military Op and the USSR 4, so the US is 3 short and the USSR gains 3 VP when the turn ends.

states.name: mil-ops-both-short
states.description: As mil-ops-shortfall at DEFCON 5, with the US on 2 and the USSR on 4: the shortfalls (3 and 1) net out to 2 VP for the USSR.

states.name: held-scoring-loses
states.description: Turn 2, the last action round: the US is to act but holds Asia Scoring, which it must play before the turn ends. Passing instead loses the game for the US.

states.name: turn-3-to-4-adds-mid-war
states.description: Turn 3, the last action round (US to act, holding Duck and Cover; USSR holds Fidel), with an empty deck and the other Early War cards in the discard pile. When the turn ends the Mid War cards are shuffled into the deck and both hands are dealt up to 9.

states.name: reshuffle-on-empty-deck
states.description: Turn 5, the last action round, with an empty deck and 12 cards in the discard pile: the deal reshuffles the discard pile and runs out of cards before the hands are full.

states.name: eagle-landed-discard
states.description: Turn 2, the last action round (US to act, holding Duck and Cover). The USSR is on space box 6, the US on 2: the USSR holds Eagle/Bear has Landed, so when the turn ends it may discard one of its two held cards (Fidel, Containment) before the deal.

states.name: eagle-landed-cancelled
states.description: As eagle-landed-discard, but the US has reached box 6 too, which cancels the perk: the turn ends with no decision to make.
